HALVERSTON COLLEGE — ACADEMIC REGULATIONS 2026/27, §12 Coursework deadlines

12.1 Instructor discretion. A course instructor may, on their own authority, grant a student an extension of up to 3 calendar days on a coursework deadline.
12.2 Registered accommodations. Students with a registered accommodation letter from Disability & Access Services that lists "extended deadlines" receive an automatic 48-hour extension on every coursework deadline. This automatic extension does not count toward the instructor's 3-day limit in 12.1 and applies on top of any instructor extension.
12.3 Anything beyond what 12.1 and 12.2 together allow requires written approval from the Dean of Students, and the total extension from all sources may never exceed 7 calendar days.
12.4 Extensions must be recorded in the gradebook before the original deadline passes.

From: Dr. Reyes, to Registrar helpdesk, Tue 2026-09-15 10:40

Registrar record for Jordan Pike: DAS accommodation letter #DAS-2291, valid 2026-08-01 to 2027-07-31. Listed accommodations: "extended deadlines (48 h)"; "exam room with reduced distractions".
Gradebook: no extension recorded yet for Essay 2. Today is Thu 2026-09-17.

decision.instructions: Can Dr. Reyes give Jordan the full extension to Sat 2026-09-26 23:59 on her own authority, without Dean of Students approval?

criteria.false: Reaching the requested deadline needs Dean of Students approval (or is not allowed at all).
criteria.true: The requested new deadline is reachable using only the instructor's discretion plus the automatic accommodation extension.
